item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Advanced load balancing in Azure Application Gateway
item.description:
Advanced load balancing for Azure Application Gateway is now in public preview. It adds more control over traffic distribution across backends for different workload types, including AI applications and web traffic.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Application Gateway confidential compute support
item.description:
Azure Application Gateway confidential compute is now in public preview. It runs the Application Gateway data plane in a confidential computing environment to help protect sensitive data while requests are being processed, including after decryption.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Centralized user authentication + JWT validation for Azure Application Gateway
item.description:
Azure Application Gateway now offers public preview for centralized user authentication using OpenID Connect, so sign-in can happen before traffic reaches the backend. The preview also includes an updated JWT validation experience.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: WAF Insights for Azure Application Gateway
item.description:
WAF Insights for Azure Application Gateway Web Application Firewall is now generally available. The feature adds built-in dashboards in the WAF policy that combine logs and metrics for investigation.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Keyless TLS on Application Gateway with Azure Key Vault Managed HSM
item.description:
Azure Application Gateway now supports keyless TLS termination with certificates stored in Azure Key Vault Managed HSM. During TLS handshakes, signatures are performed inside the HSM and the private key is not exported to the gateway.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: HTTP/3 over QUIC support in Azure Application Gateway
item.description:
Azure Application Gateway now has public preview support for HTTP/3 over QUIC. The update is intended to improve connection setup time, reduce latency, and increase resiliency for web applications and APIs.

  • Source: Azure Updates
